rules: Leave every file name unchanged so train, validation, and test stay in their official shards.
Do not copy a training row into validation or test.
Do not download the test shards again.
Fit on the training shards, select the model and threshold on validation, then score test once.

duplicates.vehicle_identifier_note: The schema has event_id, label, vehiclesize, gyro_is_hd, gsensor, gyro, and gps_speed. There is no vehicle id, so the paper's vehicle-disjoint split cannot be rebuilt. Official shard names are preserved instead.

gps_conclusion.interpretation: 103187 rows store 17 GPS samples. 53144 repeat the final sample and 34181 repeat the first sample. Those counts can overlap. 6294 rows have no adjacent duplicate, so length 17 is not one parse error. Rows stay at their stored length.

excluded_features.gps_samples: GPS list length is a storage count, not a speed. Standardizing it turns a one-sample format gap into a large score when one length dominates training.
excluded_features.imu_samples: Accelerometer list length is a storage count, not an acceleration.
excluded_features.gyro_samples: Gyroscope list length is a storage count, not a rotation.
excluded_features.gyro_is_hd: This is a sensor-resolution flag. Standardization does not put high-definition and standard gyroscope samples on one scale.
excluded_features.peak_abs_gyro_deg_s: Standard gyroscope rows can saturate near the int16 full scale, while high-definition rows use a finer resolution. One standardized column does not correct that encoding.
excluded_features.std_gyro_magnitude_deg_s: Same gyroscope encoding mismatch as the peak gyroscope feature.

peak_baseline.score: max over time of hypot(accel_x, accel_y)

accel_logistic.scaler: standard scaler fit on training rows

defensible_logistic.scaler: standard scaler fit on training rows

decision.reason: highest validation average precision; name breaks ties
decision.model_criterion: highest validation average precision; model name breaks ties
decision.threshold_criterion: maximum crash F1 on the selected model's validation scores; the lowest score wins ties
decision.use_case_note: No missed-crash versus false-alarm cost ratio was specified. Average precision ranks crash scores without an operating point. Crash F1 is the documented balanced threshold. Precision, recall, false positives, and false negatives are reported beside that choice.

by_file.balanced_accuracy_note: undefined because this slice contains only one class
by_file.average_precision_note: undefined because this slice does not contain both classes
by_file.positive_class_note: This slice has zero crash labels, so precision, recall, F1, and average precision are undefined.
